static_traits.name: Susan
static_traits.family_status: Lives independently; close relationships with parents and siblings
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with friends show tension and avoidance due to worry about being judged
static_traits.language_features: Clear expression, fairly strong logic, able to describe automatic thoughts and bodily sensations, highly cooperative; anxious mood, with tendencies toward catastrophizing, mind reading, and overgeneralization

basic_info.main_problem: I recently came out as lesbian to some friends at Comic Con; their initial silence made me believe they now hate me and think I am immoral, which causes me great pain and worry.
basic_info.core_demands: The fear of being judged and constant worry about what my friends think are affecting my mental health, so I have come to seek counseling.

core_beliefs: My value depends on others' evaluations
展现真实的自己会Being rejected

special_situations.event: After coming out to friends at Comic Con, they initially remained silent
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If others fall silent after I reveal an important identity, it means they do not approve of me or even dislike me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding further communication with friends, repeatedly rehearsing the worst-case scenario for self-protection
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: They must hate me and think I am immoral

special_situations.event: Later meeting these friends in social situations or thinking about communicating with them
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If they do not immediately express support, it means they will eventually distance themselves from me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Proactively avoids contact; postpones or evades starting conversations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will lose all my friends

special_situations.event: Recalling past experiences of friends giving support, contrasting with the silence this time
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only immediate, clear positive responses count as support; otherwise it means not accepting me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Ignoring past positive evidence and reinforcing negative interpretations of silence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Their silence this time shows they do not support me

special_situations.event: When creating a short film, being interrupted by thoughts about friends' opinions, difficulty concentrating
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Others' evaluations of me determine my worth and sense of security
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeatedly thinking about others' viewpoints, seeking certainty rather than engaging in the present task
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If they look down on me, I am worthless and cannot do work well either

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be accepted as one's true self and to maintain stable friendships
core_conflict.fear: Afraid of being judged and shamed, and ultimately rejected and abandoned
defense_goal: Reducing the risk of being rejected by avoiding contact and presuming the worst-case scenario
Replacing direct contact with rational analysis to control uncertainty

object_relations.self_representation: A vulnerable outsider who is easily judged

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When a friend stays silent or does not respond promptly after one comes out
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Interprets the other person's silence as disgust and rejection (transferentially projecting own shame onto others)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Cautious and avoidant tone, avoids directly asking the other party's intentions, mostly uses speculative expressions such as 'they must...'.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When advised to communicate with friends and needing to face uncertainty
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Believes direct communication will bring worse outcomes, thus substituting analysis for emotional contact
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Uses analytical, generalizing language to discuss 'possibilities / reasons', reduces emotional expression, and avoids present subjective feelings.

manifestations: After coming out, worries about being rejected by friends and interprets silence as negation
Avoids friends to avoid being judged; relationships gradually become distant

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'.
manifestations: In sessions, repeatedly speculated that friends 'dislike me / think I am immoral', lacking evidential support

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: Repeatedly worries about others' opinions, carefully avoiding starting conversations
Worries about being judged and does not follow up in communication with friends

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: Judges his own sexual orientation by external standards of 'morality/abnormality', producing shame and self-blame

positive_force: Having a supportive family system (close relationships with parents and siblings)
Has a many-year friendship with a friend who gave support during hard times
Willing to explore and formulate steps for communicating with friends
Possesses some self-observation and rational analysis ability (attempts rationalization and reality testing)
negative_force: Marked cognitive distortions: mind reading, overgeneralization, personalization
Catastrophizing and expectation of the worst outcome, over-relying on external evaluation
Avoidance behavior maintains anxiety and relationship distance
Mental filtering of silence and disqualifying past positive evidence
Sleep and appetite problems intensify emotional reactions and difficulties concentrating

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids contact with the friends of the person they came out to and repeatedly worries about others' evaluations, accompanied by strong anxiety and somatic reactions (chest tightness, headaches)
antecedent: Meeting these friends in social settings
Thinking about talking with friends about feelings after coming out
Recalling a friend's silence at Comic Con
target_behavior.core_reason: Equates others' silence with rejection and dislike, producing mind reading and catastrophizing inferences, worrying about being seen as immoral / disliked, and thus reduces anxiety through avoidance
target_behavior.function: Avoiding possible rejection and shame, reducing anxiety from uncertainty in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Friendships grow distant and social tension persists, rumination and anxiety are maintained, work is impaired, and sleep and appetite are disturbed
